name: app-button
title: AppButton + AppButtonVariant enum + AppButtonSize enum

public_api.constructor:
AppButton({
  required String label,
  AppButtonVariant variant = AppButtonVariant.primary,
  AppButtonSize size = AppButtonSize.md,
  Widget? icon,
  Widget? trailingIcon,
  VoidCallback? onPressed,
  bool isLoading = false,
  bool isDisabled = false,
  bool isFullWidth = false,
})
enums: enum AppButtonVariant { primary, secondary, tertiary, ghost }

conventions_reminder: All colors/spacings/radii/durations via tokens — no hardcoded values
Hover feedback via opacity 0.9 (NOT scale transform)
Press feedback: AnimatedScale scale 0.97 with AnimatedContainer for elevation
Double quotes on all string literals
Top-of-file doc comment explaining purpose + state behavior
acceptance_criteria: Size enum has sm/md/lg with appropriate height/padding per size
isDisabled sets opacity 0.5 and onPressed to null
All colors via AppColors tokens — no Color() literals
completion_summary: Implemented AppButton with 4 variants (primary/secondary/tertiary/ghost) and 3 sizes (sm/md/lg), isLoading state with CircularProgressIndicator(20px), isDisabled opacity 0.5, hover opacity 0.9 feedback, press AnimatedScale 0.97 animation, all via design tokens
